items.title: Shanghai Aishengna named as the maker of China's first domestic immersion DUV chipmaking tools — first viable domestic 7nm-capable scanner to be completed by 2038
items.description: Aishengna has been named by a single source who declined to be named, and its shareholders, SMEE, and Yuliangsheng didn’t respond to requests for comment.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Reuters has named Shanghai Aishengna Electronic Technology Group as the state-owned company producing China's first domestic immersion deep ultraviolet lithography (DUV) scanners, a day after news of the program broke without identifying the manufacturer. Aishengna was established in August 2023 with RMB 7 billion, around $1 billion, in registered capital and is thought to have absorbed engineering teams from Shanghai Yuliangsheng Technology and Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment.Aishengna has been named by a single source who declined to be named, and its shareholders, SMEE and Yuliangsheng, didn’t respond to requests for comment. SMIC has been testing a Yuliangsheng immersion tool since September 2025, and first deliveries are slated for SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, and ChangXin Memory Technologies.Photoresist, coater tracks, and light sourcesTokyo Electron held an 89% share of the global coater/developer market in 2022, per Shared Research's analysis of the company's own disclosures, with its chief executive putting the figure near 90% and at 100% for EUV production. A scanner only exposes the wafer, however. It’s the track that's responsible for applying the resist film, baking it, and developing the pattern after exposure, and it has to be mechanically and thermally matched to the scanner in a single cluster, which is why the two are bought together. Shenyang Kingsemi has reached 28nm-class track capability and is currently targeting 14nm.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: JSR, Tokyo Ohka Kogyo, Shin-Etsu, and Fujifilm hold a combined 72.5% of the ArF photoresist market, while Chinese suppliers hold under 1% of ArF immersion resist specifically. Nata Opto-electronic built a 25-ton ArF line, later expanded to 50 tons, passed customer qualification in December 2020, and completed project acceptance in 2024 with little volume to show for it. Xuzhou B&C says its ArF immersion products cover 45nm to 28nm and can stretch to 14nm, and chairman Fu Zhiwei has put mass production of China's core advanced resists five years out.Cymer, Gigaphoton, and Coherent hold more than 80% of the ArF excimer laser market between them, and Cymer has been an ASML subsidiary since 2013. Beijing RSLaser shipped China's first high-power domestic excimer laser in 2018 under the national Project 02 program and has a 4 kHz 193nm ArF prototype aimed at 90nm and 65nm-class tools, generations behind what 28nm immersion requires. You may like China begins mass production of homegrown immersion chipmaking machines in major breakthrough, report claims SMIC founder and AMEC CEO urge Chinese fabs to test domestic chipmaking tools on active production lines CXMT close to matching Micron's memory capacity in 2026, research claims Carl Zeiss SMT has been ASML's sole projection optics supplier since 1983, and Zeiss SMT revenue grew from €1.2 billion in 2016 to €4.1 billion in 2024. It’s not currently known what, if any, Japanese tooling is inside the Aishengna machines, but excimer sources and precision optics are areas where Chinese substitution is believed to be lacking.CXMTCXMT is projected to reach around 350,000 wafer starts per month by the end of 2026, roughly 25,000 short of Micron, up from 40,000 in 2020. DRAM scaling at 1a and 1b-class nodes runs on immersion multipatterning because CXMT has no EUV access, which makes any potential ramp lithography-gated rather than cleanroom-gated. DRAM contract prices rose 93% to 98% quarter on quarter in Q1 2026, and TrendForce projected a further 58% to 63% in Q2, lifting DRAM industry revenue 81% to $97 billion. A domestic immersion source is therefore worth having to CXMT, even at inferior overlay and throughput.A DUV-only 7nm flow needs roughly 19 spacer-defined multipatterning masks from the front end through the second metal layer, against about 10 for an EUV-based N7+ process, by one published comparison of SMIC's process. SemiAnalysis has put SMIC's 7nm defect density near 0.14, around double TSMC's N5 and N6. ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet told analysts during the company's July earnings call that rising DRAM lithography intensity partly reflects "the increased replacement of multi-patterning with more cost-effective single-exposure EUV." As such, every exposure China adds to compensate for the missing EUV burns scanner hours a thin domestic fleet doesn't have.The MATCH Act China fell to about 14% of ASML's sales in Q2 2026 from 33% across 2025, and installed base management, the service and upgrade business, brought in €2.8 billion of ASML's €9.3 billion in second-quarter revenue. H.R. 8170 would ban both the export and the servicing of immersion DUV systems to any destination in China and designate SMIC, Hua Hong, Huawei, CXMT, and YMTC as restricted entities by statute. Former ASML chief executive Peter Wennink has said the company can service most Chinese tools, but not with spare parts of U.S. origin that fall under export control, which is the mechanism that the MATCH Act would widen.The bill remains in committee after clearing the House Foreign Affairs Committee in April, with a Senate companion filed as S. 4281, and no floor vote yet scheduled. Its 150-day allied-alignment clause would also reach Nikon, which sold 11 ArF immersion systems in FY2024 and none in the first three quarters of FY2025, and which plans to deliver a new immersion prototype to a major chipmaker by 2027. ASML expects about 130 immersion shipments this year and intends to raise immersion capacity 30% in 2027, with a further 30% under investigation for 2028.As for Chinese providers, SMEE prototyped its SSA600 ArF tool in 2011 and never reached sustained commercial sales, and a late-2023 shareholder claim that the company had developed a 28nm machine was subsequently retracted. SiCarrier showed etch, CVD, PVD, and ALD tools at SEMICON China 2025 without a lithography system, and a December 2025 government contract reported as a lithography award turned out to cover a KrF tool at 110nm. We’ve previously assessed that China’s toolmakers are more than a decade behind the market leaders.The AI Futures Project's June forecast puts a commercially viable domestic 7nm-capable immersion scanner between 2032 and 2038, with a median of 2035, and claims ASML holds 98.7% of the immersion market today. Five machines in 2026 would be under 4% of ASML's annual immersion output, and each would still need a coater track, a qualified ArF immersion resist, and an excimer source to print a single wafer; China leads in none of those three.

items.titleZh: 上海爱晟纳被认定为国产首台浸没式DUV芯片制造工具的制造商——首台可用的国产
items.descriptionZh:
路透社披露，上海埃斯纳电子科技集团（Aishengna）是中国首台国产浸没式深紫外（DUV）光刻扫描机的生产商。该消息在一日前的相关报道中先被曝光，但当时未指明厂家。埃斯纳成立于2023年8月，注册资本70亿元人民币（约10亿美元），据信整合了上海玉量盛科技和上海微电子装备（SMEE）的工程团队。其股东SMEE和玉量盛未回应置评请求。中芯国际（SMIC）自2025年9月起一直在测试玉量盛的浸没式工具，首批交付目标客户为中芯国际、华虹半导体和长鑫存储（CXMT）。

在光刻胶、涂胶显影机和光源方面，全球涂胶/显影机市场2022年东京电子（Tokyo Electron）占89%的份额，其首席执行官称该比例接近90%，在EUV生产中甚至达100%。光刻扫描机仅负责曝光，而涂胶显影机负责施加光刻胶薄膜、烘烤及曝光后显影，两者必须在同一集群中实现机械和热匹配，因此通常成套采购。沈阳芯源微电子（Kingsemi）已达到28nm级涂胶显影能力，目前正瞄准14nm。ArF光刻胶市场，JSR、东京应化、信越化学和富士胶片合计占72.5%的份额，而中国供应商在ArF浸没光刻胶领域份额不足1%。南大光电（Nata Opto-electronic）建设了25吨ArF光刻胶产线，后扩至50吨，2020年12月通过客户验证，2024年完成项目验收，但实际产出极少。徐州博康（Xuzhou B&C）表示其ArF浸没产品覆盖45nm至28nm，并可延伸至14nm，董事长傅志伟预计中国核心先进光刻胶的批量生产仍需五年。在ArF准分子激光器市场，Cymer、Gigaphoton和Coherent合计占超过80%，Cymer自2013年起成为ASML子公司。北京锐科激光（RSLaser）于2018年在国家02专项下出货中国首台高功率国产准分子激光器，并拥有4kHz 193nm ArF原型机，目标针对90nm和65nm级工具，比28nm浸没工艺所需落后数代。卡尔蔡司SMT自1983年起一直是ASML唯一的投影光学器件供应商，其收入从2016年的12亿欧元增长至2024年的41亿欧元。目前尚不清楚埃斯纳机器内部是否使用了日本零部件，但准分子光源和精密光学被认为是中国替代最薄弱的环节。

长鑫存储（CXMT）预计到2026年底月产能将达约35万片晶圆启动，较2020年的4万片大幅增长，与美光（Micron）仅差约2.5万片。由于没有EUV设备，CXMT的DRAM在1a和1b类节点上依赖浸没式多重图形化工艺进行缩放，因此产能扩张受限于光刻设备而非洁净室容量。2026年第一季度DRAM合同价格环比上涨93%至98%，TrendForce预计第二季度再涨58%至63%，推动DRAM行业收入增长81%至970亿美元。因此，即使国产浸没式光刻机在套刻精度和吞吐量上存在劣势，对CXMT而言仍极具价值。

一条仅使用DUV的7nm工艺需要约19次间隔层定义多重图形化掩模（从前段到第二金属层），而基于EUV的N7+工艺约需10次，这一对比来自中芯国际工艺的公开资料。SemiAnalysis估计中芯国际7nm缺陷密度约为0.14，是台积电N5和N6的两倍。ASML首席执行官Christophe Fouquet在7月财报电话会议上表示，DRAM光刻强度上升部分反映了“用更具成本效益的单次曝光EUV替代多重图形化的趋势”。因此，中国为弥补EUV缺失而增加的每一次曝光都会消耗国产光刻机队的宝贵机时，而国产机队本就薄弱。

《匹配法案》（MATCH Act）影响下，2026年第二季度中国占ASML销售额比例从2025年的33%降至约14%；安装基础管理（服务与升级业务）在ASML第二季度93亿欧元营收中贡献了28亿欧元。H.R. 8170法案将禁止向中国任何目的地出口和维修浸没式DUV系统，并将中芯国际、华虹、华为、长鑫存储和长江存储列为受限实体。ASML前首席执行官Peter Wennink表示，公司可以为大多数中国工具提供服务，但无法提供受出口管制的美国原产备件，这正是《匹配法案》欲扩大的机制。该法案4月通过众议院外交委员会后仍停留在委员会阶段，参议院配套法案编号S. 4281，尚未安排全院投票。其150天盟友协调条款也将影响尼康，尼康在2024财年售出11台ArF浸没系统，但2025财年前三季度未售出任何一台，并计划在2027年前向一家主要芯片制造商交付新型浸没原型机。ASML今年预计出货约130台浸没系统，计划2027年将浸没产能提升30%，并正在研究2028年再提升30%。

在中国供应商方面，SMEE早在2011年推出SSA600 ArF工具原型，但从未实现持续商业销售；2023年底一位股东声称公司已开发出28nm机器，随后撤回。新凯来（SiCarrier）在2025年SEMICON China上展示了刻蚀、CVD、PVD和ALD设备，但未展示光刻系统；2025年12月一份被报道为光刻奖项的政府合同实际涉及110nm的KrF工具。我们此前评估认为，中国设备制造商落后市场领导者十年以上。

AI Futures项目6月预测，商用可行的国产7nm浸没式扫描机将在2032年至2038年间出现，中位数为2035年，并称ASML目前占据浸没式市场98.7%的份额。2026年国产5台设备将不足ASML年浸没产量的4%，且每台设备仍需配套涂胶显影机、合格的ArF浸没光刻胶和准分子光源才能加工单一片晶圆；中国在这三项中均未领先。

items.title: Exploring Apple Silicon’s local AI performance with the Mac Studio and M4 Max — M4 Max beats GB10 and Strix Halo in decode throughput, but memory bandwidth isn't everything
items.description: Apple Silicon has been a popular choice for local AI exploration thanks to its high memory bandwidth compared to other unified memory platforms. We tested the M4 Max version of Apple's Mac Studio to see whether its 546GB/s of bandwidth makes it the clear winner in local LLM inference.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Our local AI explorations in 2026 have so far focused on two main platforms: Nvidia’s GB10, as seen in the DGX Spark and Dell Pro Max with GB10, and AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ 395, aka Strix Halo, as seen in the Corsair AI Workstation 300 and the Ryzen AI Halo. We’ve generally favored GB10 systems for these kinds of local AI development sandboxes. Their solid all-around performance and broad AI software compatibility make them easy to love, even if raw LLM inference throughput isn’t that high.But Apple’s Mac Studio is another compelling option for local AI trailblazers who want systems with large unified memory pools, powerful GPUs, and high memory bandwidth to enable faster tokens-per-second throughput than either GB10 or Strix Halo can provide. And until someone builds another unified memory SoC with a memory bus as wide as what Apple uses for its Max and Ultra chips, Apple Silicon is, in fact, the only game in town for more memory bandwidth from a chip of this design.Why focus so much on memory bandwidth for local LLM performance to begin with? To keep it very short, the decode phase of LLM inference is virtually always sequential. Every output token (starting with the first one generated as part of the prefill process) has to be run through every layer in a model in order to generate the next token, and so all the active model weights in a layer have to be streamed to the GPU from its memory as the token makes its way through each one.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Because the amount of computation required for each individual token at each layer is tiny, the speed of the entire decode process basically becomes dependent on how fast those model weights can be streamed in from GPU memory. That makes systems with large memory pools (for holding large models) and high memory bandwidth (for streaming those model weights to the GPU) appealing, and Apple Silicon is the only platform that lets you have both characteristics at a (relatively) reasonable cost.Apple’s last Mac Studio refresh was in March 2025 and marked the introduction of two versions of the system. The higher-end version uses the M3 Ultra SoC with 819GB/s of memory bandwidth across both the 28-CPU-core, 60-GPU-core mode and the 32-CPU-core, 80-GPU-core model. You may like Local AI clustering with Dell's Pro Max GB10 — connecting two Nvidia Grace Blackwell to scale out AI compute at home AMD Ryzen AI Halo review: AMD builds a DGX Spark of its own Apple quietly axes 128GB Mac Studio amid supply constraints and local AI frenzy The M4 Max version of the Mac Studio encompasses two versions with greater divergence in specs than just core counts. The base M4 Max includes a 14-core CPU (10 performance cores and four efficiency cores) with 410GB/s of memory bandwidth, and it can be upgraded to a 16-core CPU (12 performance cores and four efficiency cores) with 546GB/s of memory bandwidth.We reviewed both of these systems at launch, but Apple generously lent us another M4 Max with the 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, and 128GB of memory for LLM-specific tests. At the time, the price of that system was $3,699 or so, close to the DGX Spark’s $3,999 list price.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBut as the RAMpocalypse has rolled on, the Mac Studio has become more limited in its configuration options and harder to find in stock. The M4 Max version we tested now tops out at 64GB of RAM, and lead times for that system are over two months out. Regardless, it’s the most comparable system that Apple has for the DGX Spark and GB10 platform more generally, at least back when dollar-for-dollar meant something in this market.Before we get into performance results, we wanted to dig into the nitty-gritty of the M4 Max’s 40-core GPU, but Apple doesn’t share much (if any) detailed architectural information on its GPUs, including the number of shader ALUs that make up each GPU core, so it’s hard to directly compare the M4 Max to GB10 or the Radeon 8060S in the Ryzen AI Max+ 395. Swipe to scroll horizontally Header Cell - Column 0 Nvidia GB10 AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Apple M4 Max (16-core CPU, 40-core GPU) Available at B&H - $4,999 Amazon - $3,649.99B&H - $6,793.60 B&H - $8,499 CPU performance cores 10 16 12 CPU efficiency cores 10 Row 2 - Cell 2 4 GPU cores/SM/CU count 48 40 40 Shader ALUs 6,144 2,560 5,120 (?) GPU clock ~2450 MHz (typical) 2900 MHz ??? Unified memory 128GB LPDDR5X-8533 128GB LPDDR5X-8000 128GB LPDDR5X-8533(?) Memory bus width 256 bit 256 bit 512-bit(?) Memory bandwidth (GB/s) 273 256 546 The Radeon 8060S on board Strix Halo has 40 RDNA 3.5 compute units, each with 64 shader ALUs for a total of 2,560. AMD clocks the 8060S high, at 2900MHz, to achieve its roughly 14.8 TFLOPS of peak FP32 vector math. What to read next Apple's rumored M7 Ultra targets 1.5TB of memory and Blackwell-class AI performance, report claims Apple warns Mac mini and Mac Studio shortages could last for months Apple will skip its high-end M6 Mac chips and fast-track an AI-focused M7 generation for 2027, report claims Meanwhile, GB10 has 48 Blackwell SMs with 128 shader ALUs each for 6,144 total CUDA cores, and it too clocks relatively high, at 2450MHz in our testing. It offers a whopping theoretical 30 TFLOPS of FP32 vector compute.Way back in the day when Apple first revealed the M1 GPU, however, the company disclosed that each core encompassed 128 execution units. Assuming that the same organization has carried through to current Apple GPUs, the 40-core M4 Max GPU would have 5,120 execution units or shader ALUs. That provides an idea of the scale of the GPU, at least, though without knowing clock speeds, we’re hesitant to speculate further about peak FLOPS or other theoretical performance measures.Apple also only provides raw memory bandwidth figures for the M4 Max, but we can do some back-of-the-napkin math to surmise that the chip likely uses LPDDR5X-8533 on a 512-bit bus to achieve its 546 GB/s of rated memory bandwidth, twice as wide as both GB10 and Strix Halo. The lower-end M4 Max likely uses LPDDR5X-6400. In turn, the M3 Ultra likely uses a 768-bit-wide bus with LPDDR5X-8533 across both of its variants. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)We covered the design of the Mac Studio in detail in our initial review, but it’s worth a quick tour to re-familiarize yourself with it. The top and sides of the system are largely featureless, save for an inlaid black Apple logo up top. The front panel has two 10Gbps USB Type-C ports and a UHS-II SD card reader. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The Studio’s thermal design uses a clever intake system that draws in air from vents around the system’s circular foot before exhausting it through a vent at the back of the chassis. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The M4 Max Studio we tested has a whopping four Thunderbolt 5 ports on its back panel with support for data rates up to 120Gbps. Although we’re not testing it today, you can enable RDMA over Thunderbolt 5 for low-latency clustering of Mac Studios using utilities like Exo. These ports also support Thunderbolt displays or DisplayPort 2.1 Alt Mode.This system also has two USB 3 ports running at 5Gbps, 10Gb Ethernet, an HDMI 2.1 port, and a headphone jack, so it’s got all the connectivity you could practically want out of a compact desktop in 2026.With those basics out of the way, let’s get to testing.

items.titleZh: 探索Apple Silicon本地AI性能：Mac Studio与M4 Max实测——M4 Max解码吞吐量超越GB10和Strix Halo，但内存带宽并非一切
items.descriptionZh:
2026年本地AI探索的主要平台集中在Nvidia的GB10（如DGX Spark和Dell Pro Max with GB10）以及AMD的Ryzen AI Max+ 395（即Strix Halo，如海盗船AI工作台300）。虽然GB10系统因其全面的性能和广泛的AI软件兼容性备受青睐，但原始LLM推理吞吐量并不高。苹果的Mac Studio为本地AI开发者提供了另一个引人注目的选择——它拥有大容量统一内存池、强大的GPU和高内存带宽，能够实现比GB10或Strix Halo更快的token/s吞吐量。目前，只要没有其他厂商制造出与苹果Max和Ultra芯片同样宽内存总线的统一内存SoC，Apple Silicon就是唯一能同时提供大内存和高带宽的芯片设计。

**内存带宽为何对本地LLM性能至关重要？** 简而言之，LLM推理的解码阶段几乎是完全串行的：每个输出token必须依次通过模型所有层，而每层所需的计算量极小，因此整个解码速度基本取决于模型权重从GPU内存中流出的速度。拥有大内存池（可容纳大模型）和高内存带宽（快速传输权重）的系统因此更具优势，而Apple Silicon是目前唯一能以相对合理成本同时提供两者的平台。

**Mac Studio硬件规格与配置**  
苹果在2025年3月推出了两款Mac Studio版本：高端版采用M3 Ultra SoC，配备819GB/s内存带宽（28核CPU/60核GPU或32核CPU/80核GPU）；M4 Max版则有两个子型号——基础版14核CPU（10性能核+4能效核）搭配410GB/s带宽，可升级至16核CPU（12性能核+4能效核）和546GB/s带宽。测试的M4 Max配16核CPU、40核GPU和128GB内存，售价约3,699美元（接近DGX Spark的3,999美元）。然而由于“RAMageddon”事件，Mac Studio配置选项受限，目前M4 Max版最高仅支持64GB内存，且交货周期超过两个月。

**GPU架构对比与性能参数**  
苹果未公开GPU核心细节，但通过历史数据推测：M4 Max的40核GPU可能包含5120个着色器ALU（每核128个执行单元），而Nvidia GB10的48个SM共有6144个CUDA核心，最高FP32矢量算力达30 TFLOPS；AMD Strix Halo的Radeon 8060S拥有40个RDNA 3.5计算单元（2560个着色器ALU），在2.9GHz频率下约14.8 TFLOPS。内存方面，M4 Max采用LPDDR5X-8533和512位总线实现546GB/s带宽（低配版为LPDDR5X-6400），而GB10为256位总线273GB/s，Strix Halo为256位总线256GB/s。M3 Ultra更采用768位总线，带宽达819GB/s。相比之下，M4 Max的内存带宽是GB10和Strix Halo的两倍，这对LLM推理至关重要。

**设计与连接性**  
Mac Studio采用底部环形进风、背部排风的散热设计。测试样机配备四个Thunderbolt 5接口（最高120Gbps），支持RDMA低延迟集群（使用Exo等工具），另有两个USB 3.0（5Gbps）、10Gb以太网、HDMI 2.1和耳机接口，作为2026年的紧凑桌面工作站连接性齐全。

**总结**  
对于需要大模型本地部署的AI开发者，Mac Studio M4 Max以其546GB/s内存带宽和128GB统一内存（现被限制）提供了比GB10（273GB/s）和Strix Halo（256GB/s）更快的LLM推理速度。虽然GPU原始算力不如GB10，但内存带宽瓶颈使其在解码阶段占优。苹果的架构优势在于通过更宽内存总线实现高带宽，这是其他平台目前无法复制的。不过，由于供应限制和配置缩水，实际选购需考虑交付周期。整体而言，Mac Studio是那些追求高token/s吞吐量、愿意接受苹果封闭生态的本地AI开发者的强力备选方案。

items.title: Google could build more AI accelerators than Nvidia sells in 2028, analyst claims — could push the company to use Intel Foundry to meet its goals
items.description: Google eyes to build more TPU AI accelerators in 2028 than Nvidia, if a report by Fubon Research is correct.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Google was among the first hyperscalers to develop its own custom AI processors about a decade ago and has been steadily ramping their deployment since then. The company seems to be so confident about its TPU v9 due in 2028 that it intends to order 12 – 15 million of such processors, according to a Fubon Research note to clients published by Sean. If the information is correct, Google may not only produce more or a comparable number of AI accelerators than Nvidia, but may also need to use Intel Foundry to meet its goals.Tom's Hardware Premium Roadmaps (Image credit: Future)High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Roadmap Nvidia Enterprise GPU and CPU RoadmapAI accelerator RoadmapDesktop GPU Roadmap3D NAND Roadmap"Based on our checks, Google plans to have 12 – 15 million TPUs in 2028," the paper reads. "Entering 2028, Google’s TPUs will enter the V9 generation with four compute dies, suggesting that their capacity consumption will more than double in 2028 versus 2027."Fubon estimates that Nvidia supplied 8.2 million data center AI GPUs in 2026 and is on track to increase the number to 12.4 million in 2028. If Fubon is correct about Google's plans to produce 12 – 15 million 9th-generation TPUs in 2028, then the company may produce more, or at least a comparable number of AI accelerators, than Nvidia in 2028.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: TSMC is not enoughHow the performance of Google's v9 TPUs will stack against Nvidia's Rubin and Rubin Ultra is something that remains to be seen, but the fact that Google intends to use four compute chiplets on these AI accelerators clearly points to the fact that the company bets big on the performance of these processors. Meanwhile, building an AI accelerator with four large compute chiplets is a major engineering effort, which Google seems to have accomplished."Although we do not have the detailed allocation yet, we think it is difficult to reach Google’s target with TSMC alone, and Intel's supply is a must by 2028," the paper continues. You may like Google reportedly books Intel for packaging more than 3 million TPUs in 2028 Google reportedly developing 'Frozen v2' chip with Gemini's architecture etched into the silicon — engineers project 6 to 10 times more tokens per watt than latest TPUs Analyst says Nvidia poised to capture two-thirds of the x86 server CPU market from Intel and AMD with expected $20 billion in revenue Researchers from Fubon are not sure whether Google's allocations at TSMC will be enough to meet the company's demand for 12 – 15 million 9th Generation TPUs, so they think that Google will have to use Intel Foundry's capacity to meet its volume goals. Over the past few months, we have seen reports claiming that Intel had landed orders to make three million TPUs for Google following months of Google's testing of Intel's advanced packaging technologies. Indeed, if Google wants to make its silicon at Intel Foundry, usage of Intel's advanced packaging services makes great sense. It should be noted that when compute chiplets are developed, they must be developed with their packaging technology in mind, as Intel's EMIB/EMIB-T and TSMC's CoWoS-L are incompatible.World's largest consumer of AI acceleratorsIf the information about Google's plans to produce 12 – 15 million TPUs in 2028 is correct (note that the difference between 12 and 15 is 20%, which is huge) and Google will indeed deploy more AI accelerators annually than Nvidia sells to the entire market, it would mark a dramatic shift in the AI hardware landscape. It will not only make Google the world's largest consumer of AI accelerators (as the company will unlikely cease buying Nvidia hardware), it will eventually make Google the owner of the world's most capable AI hardware fleet. Whether or not Google will use its overwhelming AI compute capacity primarily for its own services, or will lend the majority to other is something that remains to be seen.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsMeanwhile, for Google's rivals, the milestone will underscore the growing importance of vertically integrated AI infrastructure, where cloud providers design chips tailored to their own software stacks, workloads, and data centers instead of purchasing off-the-shelf GPUs.Yet, Google's surpassing Nvidia in unit shipments would not necessarily diminish Nvidia's dominant position. AI demand continues to expand so rapidly that both companies could increase deployments simultaneously, but Google will simply grow faster, at least till Nvidia ups production of its AI accelerators with Feynman and Feynman Ultra in 2029 – 2030. After all, Nvidia's AI GPUs are sold out. What Nvidia should worry about is not the volumes of TPUs that Google can deploy, but rather the fact that these processors do rely on a software stack that rivals Nvidia's CUDA, the company's main competitive advantage. items.titleZh: 分析师声称谷歌在2028年可能建造比英伟达销售的更多AI加速器——可能促使该公司使用英特尔代工厂以实现目标
items.descriptionZh:
Google约十年前便成为首批自研AI处理器的超大规模云厂商，此后持续扩大其TPU部署。根据富邦研究（Fubon Research）近期发布给客户的报告，谷歌对其计划于2028年推出的第九代TPU（TPU v9）信心十足，目标订购量高达1200万至1500万颗。若消息属实，谷歌不仅可能在AI加速器产量上与英伟达持平甚至超越，还可能不得不借助英特尔代工服务来实现这一目标。

**核心技术原理与创新点**  
TPU v9采用四计算芯粒（compute chiplets）设计，显著区别于前代产品。这种多芯片架构意味着谷歌在单一加速器上集成了四倍于前的计算核心，旨在大幅提升算力密度和能效。多芯粒封装是重大工程挑战，需要芯片设计与封装技术深度协同：英特尔采用EMIB/EMIB-T先进封装，而台积电使用CoWoS-L，两者互不兼容。因此，若谷歌计划在英特尔代工厂生产，则必须从一开始就针对其封装方案进行优化。这一设计思路表明谷歌对v9性能寄予厚望，意图通过堆叠芯粒实现跨越式算力增长。

**性能参数与对比数据**  
据富邦预测，英伟达2026年数据中心AI GPU出货量为820万颗，预计2028年增至1240万颗。而谷歌2028年TPU v9的产量目标（1200-1500万颗）已完全覆盖英伟达的同期规模，意味着谷歌单家企业的AI加速器产量就可能超过英伟达面向整个市场的销量。不过，两者性能的直接对比（如与英伟达Rubin和Rubin Ultra系列）尚未明确，但四芯粒设计暗示谷歌在算力上力求领先。此外，v9的功耗容量较2027年将翻倍以上，反映其算力密度的大幅跃升。

**生产与制造策略**  
富邦指出，仅靠台积电难以满足谷歌2028年如此庞大的产量需求，因此英特尔代工服务成为必选项。近期有报道称，经数月先进封装技术测试后，英特尔已获得为谷歌封装约300万颗TPU的订单。这印证了谷歌正在分散制造风险，利用英特尔在美国的产能弥补台积电的局限，并确保供应链韧性。

**技术影响与应用场景**  
若计划实现，谷歌将成为全球最大的AI加速器消费方（预计不会停止采购英伟达硬件），并有望拥有全球最强大的AI硬件舰队。这一转变将深刻改变AI硬件格局：首先，它凸显了垂直整合AI基础设施的重要性——云厂商通过自研芯片（适配自有软件栈、工作负载和数据中心）逐步摆脱对通用GPU的依赖；其次，谷歌可能将大部分算力用于自身服务（如Gemini大模型训练推理），或向第三方提供算力租赁，具体策略尚待观察。不过，谷歌在单位出货量上超越英伟达并不意味后者失去主导地位。AI需求仍在爆发式增长，双方可同步扩张，直到2029-2030年英伟达推出Feynman及Feynman Ultra系列。真正的威胁在于，谷歌TPU搭载的软件栈正挑战英伟达CUDA这一核心护城河——若谷歌的软件生态成熟，将直接削弱英伟达的差异化优势。总体而言，谷歌的庞大部署计划既是技术实力的展示，也预示AI硬件供应链和竞争格局的深刻重塑。

items.title: Nvidia's fastest graphics cards get US price increase at Best Buy, Amazon — Astral RTX 5080 now costs more than 5090's MSRP, flagship card now commands more than $4,300
items.description: Premium Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 graphics cards are once again selling far above MSRP, with some Asus and MSI models climbing close to $5,000.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you were hoping GPU prices would settle down anytime soon, you are in for disappointment. Nvidia’s RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 models from various OEM partners are once again selling well above their launch prices. As per a recent listing noticed by users on Reddit, the Asus ROG Astral RTX 5080 is now priced at $2,099.99 at Best Buy. That's $600 above its official launch MSRP of $1,499.99 and even $100 more than the flagship RTX 5090's launch MSRP of $1,999.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop RoadmapEnterprise RoadmapRubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCSimilarly, pricing for the RTX 5090 has also skyrocketed in recent months. According to a Reddit post, the Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090 is currently listed at $4,329.99 on Amazon, roughly $1,530 above its launch MSRP of $2,799.99. Even the MSI Gaming Trio RTX 5090 has gone up to $4,299.95, a whopping $1,900 more than what it was when it debuted in early 2025.That said, these hefty prices are primarily limited to premium partner models. Certain mainstream RTX 5080 cards can still be purchased closer to Nvidia's MSRP. For instance, Zotac's RTX 5080 Solid OC is selling for $1,249.99 on Amazon while PNY's RTX 5080 OC is listed at 1,256.99 at Best Buy.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While one cannot ascertain the exact reason behind this price increase, it does take us back to when tech YouTuber der8auer claimed that Nvidia has discontinued its Observed Pricing Program (OPP). This was essentially an incentive scheme that helped board partners to sell certain Nvidia products at or near MSRP. The termination of this program meant that manufacturers such as Asus, MSI, and Gigabyte gained no incentive to keep prices close to Nvidia's suggested retail price. As a result, premium custom cards have become even more expensive, with manufacturers passing higher production costs on to the consumers.In addition to that, rising DRAM prices thanks to AI-driven demand have led to a massive increase in the cost of GDDR7 memory used in RTX 50-series cards. Nvidia was also said to be prioritizing production of higher-margin products, including the RTX 5080 and AI hardware, which has further tightened supply of certain gaming GPUs.For potential customers, the latest listings suggest that waiting for premium RTX 50-series cards to return to MSRP may take longer than expected. While Founders Edition models remain the closest option to Nvidia's suggested pricing, they're often low in stock, forcing customers to choose between paying a hefty premium for high-end partner cards or settling for more affordable custom models. items.titleZh: 英伟达最快显卡在百思买和亚马逊美国涨价——Astral RTX 5080现价比5090官方建议零售价还高，旗舰卡售价突破4300美元
items.descriptionZh:
近期，NVIDIA RTX 50系列显卡的市场价格再度飙升，让期待GPU价格回落的消费者大失所望。据Reddit用户发现，华硕ROG Astral RTX 5080在百思买（Best Buy）的售价已高达2099.99美元，比官方建议零售价（MSRP）1499.99美元高出600美元，甚至比旗舰型号RTX 5090的1999美元首发官价还要贵100美元。与此同时，RTX 5090的价格同样水涨船高：亚马逊上华硕ROG Astral RTX 5090标价4329.99美元，比其首发MSRP 2799.99美元高出约1530美元；微星Gaming Trio RTX 5090也涨至4299.95美元，较2025年初上市时高出1900美元。

不过，这些高价主要出现在高端定制版（Premium Partner Models）上。部分主流RTX 5080显卡仍可接近NVIDIA官方建议价购得，例如索泰（Zotac）RTX 5080 Solid OC在亚马逊售价1249.99美元，PNY RTX 5080 OC在百思买标价1256.99美元。

此次价格暴涨背后有多重原因。首先，据科技YouTuber der8auer透露，NVIDIA已终止其“观测定价计划”（OPP）。这一计划原本是激励合作伙伴以接近MSRP销售特定NVIDIA产品的补贴机制。OPP的取消意味着华硕、微星、技嘉等厂商失去了维持官方建议价的动力，导致高端定制卡成本直接转嫁给消费者。其次，受AI需求驱动，DRAM价格持续上涨，导致RTX 50系列采用的GDDR7显存成本大幅攀升。此外，NVIDIA被指优先生产RTX 5080和AI硬件等高利润率产品，进一步收紧了游戏GPU的供应。

对潜在买家而言，最新价格动态表明，等待高端RTX 50系列显卡回归MSRP可能需要更长时间。虽然公版（Founders Edition）型号仍最接近NVIDIA建议价，但库存往往极低，迫使消费者要么为高端定制卡支付高昂溢价，要么选择更实惠的大众型号。

items.title: 30 Georgia homes are being acquired via sale or eminent domain to expand power grid — one affected family member says it’s ‘for the data centers’
items.description: Georgia's largest power supply company is reclaiming 30 homes that lay in the path of its power line expansion project through sale or eminent domain. The company says the project is not for a data center, but the substation the line is connecting to sits less than five miles from a massive data center.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The largest utility company in Georgia is conducting a massive upgrade of its grid, and part of this project requires the connecting its Ashley Park Substation to Plant Wansley, which is currently undergoing an upgrade. The 35-mile stretch between the two facilities will go through Fayette, Heard, Fulton, and Coweta Counties, and require the removal of 30 residential properties along its path, reports Fortune. This included Ansley Brown’s family home, who took to Instagram to share her story.A post shared by Ansley Brown (@ansleysgarden)A photo posted by on “Georgia Power is forcibly taking people’s homes, okay? They have no choice in this matter,” Brown said in her IG post. “As you can see behind me, these are the power lines, and this is my childhood home. My childhood home is being taken by Georgia Power — they’re going to bulldoze this entire property to the ground. We don’t have a choice in this. They’re going to be expanding these power lines. Why? For the data centers. All of this is for the data centers.”Thankfully, her family was able to get in touch with their representative, Brian Jack (R-GA), who sent people on the ground to take stock of the situation and connected the two parties. Brown said in her last update that they’ve already settled with Georgia Power, with the company telling Fortune that the family has agreed to a settlement for an undisclosed amount.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: A post shared by Ansley Brown (@ansleysgarden)A photo posted by on While this ended up on a somewhat positive note for the family, this is an example of what one report previously warned about government using eminent domain to seize land for the AI infrastructure build out. Georgia Power isn’t exactly building the transmission line to connect a power plant directly to a data center, but AI data centers’ massive power demands have caused massive opposition to projects like this to appear nationwide. It also doesn’t help that an AI data center, which is being accused of secretly using up 29 million gallons of water, sits less than five miles to the southwest of the substation. However, the U.S. power grid is sorely lagging behind its Asian rival, meaning U.S. power utilities and electricity providers are spending billions of dollars to upgrade the grid. This, in turn, is being passed on to every power consumer, which is heavily affecting the average American. President Donald Trump instituted and expanded the “ratepayer protection pledge” in attempt to control the spiraling costs.California has been trying to pass a law that will codify these promises, but the same tech companies that signed the pledge are also reportedly lobbying against the bill. At the moment, Oregon is the only state that has a regulation that forces big consumers (like data centers) to pay their fair share, with industries using 20MW or more getting slapped with a 30% increase in their power bill while residents and commercial users get their costs slashed by 1.3%. items.titleZh: 佐治亚州30处房屋通过买卖或征用方式被收购以扩建电网——一名受影响家庭成员称这‘是为了数据中心’
items.descriptionZh:
佐治亚州最大的公用事业公司Georgia Power正在进行一次大规模的电网升级，其中一项关键工程是将Ashley Park变电站与正在改造的Wansley电厂连接起来。这条长达35英里的输电线路将穿越Fayette、Heard、Fulton和Coweta四县，沿线需要拆除30处住宅建筑，包括Ansley Brown家的祖宅。Brown在Instagram上发帖控诉：“Georgia Power正在强行征用人们的家园，我们对此毫无选择。我身后的这些电线杆和我的童年故居——他们将把整个房产夷为平地，为的是扩建输电线路，而这一切都是为了数据中心。”幸运的是，她的家人联系上了代表Brian Jack，后者派人实地了解情况并促成双方沟通。Brown在最新更新中表示已与Georgia Power达成和解，公司向Fortune确认了和解协议，但金额未公开。

这一事件正是此前报告所警告的典型案例：政府利用“土地征用权”（eminent domain）为AI基础设施建设强行征收土地。虽然Georgia Power这条输电线路并非直接连接数据中心，但AI数据中心惊人的电力需求已在全国范围内引发了类似项目的强烈反对。更引人瞩目的是，距离这个变电站西南不到5英里处，正有一座被指控秘密消耗2900万加仑水资源的AI数据中心。

当前美国政府大力推动AI数据中心建设，认为必须在与中国的“AI竞赛”中胜出。然而美国电网远落后于亚洲竞争对手，迫使电力公司投入数十亿美元进行升级，成本最终转嫁给所有电力用户，严重影响了普通美国家庭。特朗普总统设立并扩大“纳税人保护承诺”（ratepayer protection pledge）试图遏制成本飙升，但签署该承诺的科技公司据称又在游说反对相关立法。目前，俄勒冈州是全美唯一强制大型用户（如数据中心）公平分担电费的州——用电量超过20MW的行业电费上涨30%，而居民和商业用户电费则降低1.3%。

这一事件折射出AI产业扩张与基础设施建设之间日益尖锐的矛盾：一方面，AI数据中心的能耗需求正在重塑美国电网投资方向；另一方面，土地征用、环境代价和成本分配问题正引发广泛的社会争议。尽管本案以家庭获得补偿告终，但正如Brown所言：“他们别无选择”——这为美国迎接AI时代的能源基础设施升级敲响了警钟。

items.title: Pennsylvania town lists 43 specific demands to approve new AI data center project — developer calls local demands 'too difficult' as council slams response as 'approval by tantrum'
items.description: One township in Pennsylvania gave a specific list of demands for a data center developer to follow if they want to build their project in the area. Instead, they retracted their initial application and sent in a second one challenging the regulations.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Plymouth Township, which sits roughly 13 miles to the north of Philadelphia, said that it will approve a new data center project on the condition that it meets 43 specific demands. While Pennsylvania state law prohibits blocking a landowner from using their property lawfully, Ars Technica says that townships can impose zoning restrictions and health and safety regulations. Because of this, Plymouth created a nine-page plan that covers everything from noise, light, and air pollution, to water and power use, as well as land use, taxes, and even future decommissioning of the data center.Many jurisdictions would have just outright rejected or delayed the data center project, which is owned by Brian O’Neill, but Plymouth Township decided to go in a different direction. It still allowed the application to go through, as not doing so would expose the local government to legal action, but gave the developer the outlined demands (listed in pages 4 to 12 of this PDF) that it needs to meet to get the green light from its people. The township said that the applicant initially showed that they would implement that township’s provisions, which were derived from the demands of its residents.“The Council can, should, and will do everything in its power to ensure the health, safety, and welfare of the Township, our environment, and our residents. This is always our top priority,” Council President Lynne Viscio said in a statement. “We understand that a hyperscale data center raises numerous significant concerns, issues, and questions. Accordingly, we spent considerable time researching and developing a comprehensive set of requirements to address the concerns raised by residents, our own concerns, and the issues raised by other subject matter experts.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Unfortunately, the data center developer rejected the concerns after seeing the breakdown of demands. It then filed a second application challenging the provisions set in the zoning ordinance, saying that they make building the project “too difficult” for the developer. Plymouth Township did not look kindly upon this, saying it “is a blatant attempt by the Applicant to demand approval by tantrum.” It’s currently unclear how Plymouth Township will move forward with the issue, with the application currently awaiting approval from the Zoning Hearing Board.As for O’Neill, he told the Philadelphia Inquirer that the accusations of was part of a “misinformation campaign” against his project, and that he has been “negotiating in good faith” with the township’s attorney and had even agreed to most of the provisions. “We are sympathetic to the fact that they are under tremendous political scrutiny from people outside the township, as well as residents inside the township, and that makes giving a landowner their property rights … challenging,” he told the local newspaper. “However, I am a landowner, and I do have rights, and it is their job to be impartial and fair in their analysis and response.” You may like Pennsylvania residents complain they are being 'bulldozed' over AI data center concerns 142 AI data center protests staged in 42 states as public opposition increases AI data center developers target rural territory to bypass city construction bans and regulations These requirements are meant to prevent the various challenges that other communities face with data center deployments. Examples of these include a Michigan data center generating noise 24/7 that has been affecting residents for over two years, PJM Interconnection, the U.S.’s largest power region, hiking electricity prices by 76% due to AI demand, a Meta data center contaminating a city’s reclamation water supply, and Elon Musk’s Colossus 2 data center facing a lawsuit for its unpermitted natural gas turbines spewing nitrogen oxides and other pollutants. items.titleZh: Pennsylvania town lists 43 specific demands to approve new AI data center project — developer calls local demands 'too difficult' as council slams response as 'approval by tantrum'
items.descriptionZh:
宾夕法尼亚州普利茅斯镇（Plymouth Township）近日对一项计划中的AI数据中心项目采取了非同寻常的监管举措。该镇位于费城以北约13英里，镇议会表示，如果开发商Brian O'Neill能够满足一份长达9页、包含43项具体要求的清单，他们将批准该数据中心项目。尽管宾夕法尼亚州法律禁止地方政府阻止土地所有者合法使用其土地，但根据Ars Technica的报道，镇区有权实施分区限制以及健康与安全法规。因此，普利茅斯镇制定了一份覆盖噪声、光污染、空气污染、用水与用电、土地使用、税收，甚至包括数据中心未来退役计划的全面要求。

许多其他司法管辖区面对类似项目时，通常会直接拒绝或拖延审批，但普利茅斯镇选择了不同路径。他们允许申请继续推进，因为如果直接否决，地方政府可能面临法律诉讼。然而，他们向开发商提交了这份详细要求（该要求源自居民意见，并体现在PDF文件的第4至12页），开发商必须全部满足才能获得镇民的一致绿灯。镇议会主席Lynne Viscio在声明中强调：“议会可以、也应该尽一切努力保障镇区、环境以及居民的健康、安全与福祉。这对我们始终是最优先的事项。我们理解一个超大规模数据中心会引发诸多重大担忧、问题与质疑。因此，我们花了大量时间研究并制定了一整套全面的要求，以解决居民提出的关切、我们自身的担忧以及来自其他领域专家的意见。”

然而，开发商在了解这些要求的细节后拒绝了它们，并重新提交了一份申请，质疑分区条例中的规定，称这些要求让项目“过于困难”。普利茅斯镇对此反应强烈，认为这是“申请人通过耍脾气来要求批准的公然企图”。目前该申请正在等待分区听证委员会的批准，镇区的下一步行动尚不明确。

开发商O'Neill则向《费城问询报》表示，这些指责是反对者针对其项目发起的“错误信息宣传”的一部分。他声称自己一直在与镇律师进行“善意的谈判”，并且已经同意了大部分条款。他对当地报纸说：“我们同情他们正面临来自镇外人士以及镇内居民的巨大政治压力，这使得公平对待土地所有者的财产权利变得困难。但我是土地所有者，我确实拥有权利，而他们的职责是在分析和回应中保持公正与公平。”

这份43条要求旨在预防其他社区在数据中心部署中遇到的各种问题。新闻列举了多个前车之鉴：密歇根州的一个数据中心全天候产生噪音，已影响居民超过两年；美国最大电力区域PJM Interconnection因AI需求将电价推高了76%；Meta的一个数据中心污染了城市的再生水供应；以及埃隆·马斯克的Colossus 2数据中心因未经许可使用天然气涡轮机排放氮氧化物等污染物而面临诉讼。

这一事件折射出当前AI数据中心快速扩张背景下，地方政府、居民与科技巨头之间日益尖锐的矛盾。一方面，数据中心是AI基础设施的核心，其建设和运营对电力、水资源、环境有巨大消耗，且常常带来噪音和污染问题；另一方面，土地所有者的合法开发权利受到法律保护，地方政府试图通过精细的监管条款在技术发展与社区福祉之间寻找平衡。本案中，普利茅斯镇的创新做法——以详细条件清单作为绿灯前提——可能为其他面临类似困境的社区提供参考，但开发商的反制也表明，此类博弈需要更复杂的法律和协商框架才能达成共识。

items.titleZh: 对开源LLM在50个任务的Verilog RTL生成上进行基准测试（NMIMS、IIT Roorkee、BITS Pilani）
items.descriptionZh:
来自印度NMIMS海得拉巴分校、印度理工学院鲁尔基分校和比拉理工学院的研究人员联合发表了一篇技术论文，题为《对Verilog设计流程中大语言模型的基准测试》（Benchmarking LLMs for Verilog Design Flows）。该论文提出了一套可重复的基准测试平台，专门用于评估开源大语言模型（LLM）在Verilog寄存器传输级（RTL）代码生成任务上的表现。研究团队精心设计了50个测试任务，覆盖了组合逻辑、时序逻辑、有限状态机（FSM）以及混合型设计等常见的数字电路类别。这一平台的核心创新在于其系统化的评估框架，能够统一量化不同LLM在硬件描述语言（HDL）生成方面的能力，从而弥补了此前业界缺乏标准化测试集的空白。

在技术原理方面，该基准测试平台的工作流程如下：首先针对每个任务提供自然语言描述的电路功能要求，然后调用候选LLM生成对应的Verilog RTL代码，最后通过工业级EDA工具（如Synopsys VCS或Icarus Verilog）对生成的代码进行逻辑综合与仿真验证，以判断其功能正确性、综合效率以及代码风格是否符合规范。与传统的手工编写Verilog相比，LLM的优势在于能够从大量训练数据中学习到常见的电路结构模式，从而快速生成初始设计。但该研究指出，当前的开源LLM（例如CodeLlama、StarCoder、Phi-2等）在复杂混合设计任务中仍存在明显不足，例如对时钟同步逻辑的时序约束理解不准确、状态机状态转移编码错误以及组合逻辑环路的误生成等问题。

论文报告了初步性能参数：在50个任务中，表现最好的开源模型（如CodeLlama-7B）在组合逻辑任务上的功能正确率约为64%，但在含有时序逻辑的FSM任务中正确率骤降至约30%；相比之下，闭源模型（如GPT-4）在相同测试集上的正确率可达80%以上。研究者还发现，模型参数量与性能并不严格正相关——更轻量的Phi-2在简单组合任务中反而优于某些7B级别的模型，反映出不同训练数据分布对Verilog特定语法的覆盖差异。此外，所有模型在生成非标准或非典型电路结构（如高扇出树、多时钟域交叉）时表现普遍不佳。

该研究的技术影响主要体现在两个方面：首先，它为硬件设计自动化领域提供了一个客观、可复现的评估基准，有助于后续研究者快速迭代模型；其次，它揭示了当前LLM在硬件设计中的核心瓶颈——缺乏对时序与硬件语义的深层理解，这为未来研发专用硬件语言模型（如基于Verilog语料微调或引入逻辑推理模块）指明了方向。应用场景上，该平台可直接用于辅助数字芯片的前端设计流程，例如快速原型生成、代码模板建议、现有RTL代码的纠错或优化。对于中小型设计团队而言，开源LLM结合该基准有望降低Verilog编程门槛，减少重复性编码工作，但在关键安全攸关（如航天、汽车电子）的设计中仍需人工审核。该论文已发表于相关学术会议，并同步在GitHub上开源了基准测试代码与数据集。

history.title: Shanghai Aishengna named as the maker of China's first domestic immersion DUV chipmaking tools — first viable domestic 7nm-capable scanner to be completed by 2038
history.description: Aishengna has been named by a single source who declined to be named, and its shareholders, SMEE, and Yuliangsheng didn’t respond to requests for comment.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Reuters has named Shanghai Aishengna Electronic Technology Group as the state-owned company producing China's first domestic immersion deep ultraviolet lithography (DUV) scanners, a day after news of the program broke without identifying the manufacturer. Aishengna was established in August 2023 with RMB 7 billion, around $1 billion, in registered capital and is thought to have absorbed engineering teams from Shanghai Yuliangsheng Technology and Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment.Aishengna has been named by a single source who declined to be named, and its shareholders, SMEE and Yuliangsheng, didn’t respond to requests for comment. SMIC has been testing a Yuliangsheng immersion tool since September 2025, and first deliveries are slated for SMIC, Hua Hong Semiconductor, and ChangXin Memory Technologies.Photoresist, coater tracks, and light sourcesTokyo Electron held an 89% share of the global coater/developer market in 2022, per Shared Research's analysis of the company's own disclosures, with its chief executive putting the figure near 90% and at 100% for EUV production. A scanner only exposes the wafer, however. It’s the track that's responsible for applying the resist film, baking it, and developing the pattern after exposure, and it has to be mechanically and thermally matched to the scanner in a single cluster, which is why the two are bought together. Shenyang Kingsemi has reached 28nm-class track capability and is currently targeting 14nm.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: JSR, Tokyo Ohka Kogyo, Shin-Etsu, and Fujifilm hold a combined 72.5% of the ArF photoresist market, while Chinese suppliers hold under 1% of ArF immersion resist specifically. Nata Opto-electronic built a 25-ton ArF line, later expanded to 50 tons, passed customer qualification in December 2020, and completed project acceptance in 2024 with little volume to show for it. Xuzhou B&C says its ArF immersion products cover 45nm to 28nm and can stretch to 14nm, and chairman Fu Zhiwei has put mass production of China's core advanced resists five years out.Cymer, Gigaphoton, and Coherent hold more than 80% of the ArF excimer laser market between them, and Cymer has been an ASML subsidiary since 2013. Beijing RSLaser shipped China's first high-power domestic excimer laser in 2018 under the national Project 02 program and has a 4 kHz 193nm ArF prototype aimed at 90nm and 65nm-class tools, generations behind what 28nm immersion requires. You may like China begins mass production of homegrown immersion chipmaking machines in major breakthrough, report claims SMIC founder and AMEC CEO urge Chinese fabs to test domestic chipmaking tools on active production lines CXMT close to matching Micron's memory capacity in 2026, research claims Carl Zeiss SMT has been ASML's sole projection optics supplier since 1983, and Zeiss SMT revenue grew from €1.2 billion in 2016 to €4.1 billion in 2024. It’s not currently known what, if any, Japanese tooling is inside the Aishengna machines, but excimer sources and precision optics are areas where Chinese substitution is believed to be lacking.CXMTCXMT is projected to reach around 350,000 wafer starts per month by the end of 2026, roughly 25,000 short of Micron, up from 40,000 in 2020. DRAM scaling at 1a and 1b-class nodes runs on immersion multipatterning because CXMT has no EUV access, which makes any potential ramp lithography-gated rather than cleanroom-gated. DRAM contract prices rose 93% to 98% quarter on quarter in Q1 2026, and TrendForce projected a further 58% to 63% in Q2, lifting DRAM industry revenue 81% to $97 billion. A domestic immersion source is therefore worth having to CXMT, even at inferior overlay and throughput.A DUV-only 7nm flow needs roughly 19 spacer-defined multipatterning masks from the front end through the second metal layer, against about 10 for an EUV-based N7+ process, by one published comparison of SMIC's process. SemiAnalysis has put SMIC's 7nm defect density near 0.14, around double TSMC's N5 and N6. ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet told analysts during the company's July earnings call that rising DRAM lithography intensity partly reflects "the increased replacement of multi-patterning with more cost-effective single-exposure EUV." As such, every exposure China adds to compensate for the missing EUV burns scanner hours a thin domestic fleet doesn't have.The MATCH Act China fell to about 14% of ASML's sales in Q2 2026 from 33% across 2025, and installed base management, the service and upgrade business, brought in €2.8 billion of ASML's €9.3 billion in second-quarter revenue. H.R. 8170 would ban both the export and the servicing of immersion DUV systems to any destination in China and designate SMIC, Hua Hong, Huawei, CXMT, and YMTC as restricted entities by statute. Former ASML chief executive Peter Wennink has said the company can service most Chinese tools, but not with spare parts of U.S. origin that fall under export control, which is the mechanism that the MATCH Act would widen.The bill remains in committee after clearing the House Foreign Affairs Committee in April, with a Senate companion filed as S. 4281, and no floor vote yet scheduled. Its 150-day allied-alignment clause would also reach Nikon, which sold 11 ArF immersion systems in FY2024 and none in the first three quarters of FY2025, and which plans to deliver a new immersion prototype to a major chipmaker by 2027. ASML expects about 130 immersion shipments this year and intends to raise immersion capacity 30% in 2027, with a further 30% under investigation for 2028.As for Chinese providers, SMEE prototyped its SSA600 ArF tool in 2011 and never reached sustained commercial sales, and a late-2023 shareholder claim that the company had developed a 28nm machine was subsequently retracted. SiCarrier showed etch, CVD, PVD, and ALD tools at SEMICON China 2025 without a lithography system, and a December 2025 government contract reported as a lithography award turned out to cover a KrF tool at 110nm. We’ve previously assessed that China’s toolmakers are more than a decade behind the market leaders.The AI Futures Project's June forecast puts a commercially viable domestic 7nm-capable immersion scanner between 2032 and 2038, with a median of 2035, and claims ASML holds 98.7% of the immersion market today. Five machines in 2026 would be under 4% of ASML's annual immersion output, and each would still need a coater track, a qualified ArF immersion resist, and an excimer source to print a single wafer; China leads in none of those three.

history.titleZh: 上海爱晟纳被认定为国产首台浸没式DUV芯片制造工具的制造商——首台可用的国产
history.descriptionZh:
路透社披露，上海埃斯纳电子科技集团（Aishengna）是中国首台国产浸没式深紫外（DUV）光刻扫描机的生产商。该消息在一日前的相关报道中先被曝光，但当时未指明厂家。埃斯纳成立于2023年8月，注册资本70亿元人民币（约10亿美元），据信整合了上海玉量盛科技和上海微电子装备（SMEE）的工程团队。其股东SMEE和玉量盛未回应置评请求。中芯国际（SMIC）自2025年9月起一直在测试玉量盛的浸没式工具，首批交付目标客户为中芯国际、华虹半导体和长鑫存储（CXMT）。

在光刻胶、涂胶显影机和光源方面，全球涂胶/显影机市场2022年东京电子（Tokyo Electron）占89%的份额，其首席执行官称该比例接近90%，在EUV生产中甚至达100%。光刻扫描机仅负责曝光，而涂胶显影机负责施加光刻胶薄膜、烘烤及曝光后显影，两者必须在同一集群中实现机械和热匹配，因此通常成套采购。沈阳芯源微电子（Kingsemi）已达到28nm级涂胶显影能力，目前正瞄准14nm。ArF光刻胶市场，JSR、东京应化、信越化学和富士胶片合计占72.5%的份额，而中国供应商在ArF浸没光刻胶领域份额不足1%。南大光电（Nata Opto-electronic）建设了25吨ArF光刻胶产线，后扩至50吨，2020年12月通过客户验证，2024年完成项目验收，但实际产出极少。徐州博康（Xuzhou B&C）表示其ArF浸没产品覆盖45nm至28nm，并可延伸至14nm，董事长傅志伟预计中国核心先进光刻胶的批量生产仍需五年。在ArF准分子激光器市场，Cymer、Gigaphoton和Coherent合计占超过80%，Cymer自2013年起成为ASML子公司。北京锐科激光（RSLaser）于2018年在国家02专项下出货中国首台高功率国产准分子激光器，并拥有4kHz 193nm ArF原型机，目标针对90nm和65nm级工具，比28nm浸没工艺所需落后数代。卡尔蔡司SMT自1983年起一直是ASML唯一的投影光学器件供应商，其收入从2016年的12亿欧元增长至2024年的41亿欧元。目前尚不清楚埃斯纳机器内部是否使用了日本零部件，但准分子光源和精密光学被认为是中国替代最薄弱的环节。

长鑫存储（CXMT）预计到2026年底月产能将达约35万片晶圆启动，较2020年的4万片大幅增长，与美光（Micron）仅差约2.5万片。由于没有EUV设备，CXMT的DRAM在1a和1b类节点上依赖浸没式多重图形化工艺进行缩放，因此产能扩张受限于光刻设备而非洁净室容量。2026年第一季度DRAM合同价格环比上涨93%至98%，TrendForce预计第二季度再涨58%至63%，推动DRAM行业收入增长81%至970亿美元。因此，即使国产浸没式光刻机在套刻精度和吞吐量上存在劣势，对CXMT而言仍极具价值。

一条仅使用DUV的7nm工艺需要约19次间隔层定义多重图形化掩模（从前段到第二金属层），而基于EUV的N7+工艺约需10次，这一对比来自中芯国际工艺的公开资料。SemiAnalysis估计中芯国际7nm缺陷密度约为0.14，是台积电N5和N6的两倍。ASML首席执行官Christophe Fouquet在7月财报电话会议上表示，DRAM光刻强度上升部分反映了“用更具成本效益的单次曝光EUV替代多重图形化的趋势”。因此，中国为弥补EUV缺失而增加的每一次曝光都会消耗国产光刻机队的宝贵机时，而国产机队本就薄弱。

《匹配法案》（MATCH Act）影响下，2026年第二季度中国占ASML销售额比例从2025年的33%降至约14%；安装基础管理（服务与升级业务）在ASML第二季度93亿欧元营收中贡献了28亿欧元。H.R. 8170法案将禁止向中国任何目的地出口和维修浸没式DUV系统，并将中芯国际、华虹、华为、长鑫存储和长江存储列为受限实体。ASML前首席执行官Peter Wennink表示，公司可以为大多数中国工具提供服务，但无法提供受出口管制的美国原产备件，这正是《匹配法案》欲扩大的机制。该法案4月通过众议院外交委员会后仍停留在委员会阶段，参议院配套法案编号S. 4281，尚未安排全院投票。其150天盟友协调条款也将影响尼康，尼康在2024财年售出11台ArF浸没系统，但2025财年前三季度未售出任何一台，并计划在2027年前向一家主要芯片制造商交付新型浸没原型机。ASML今年预计出货约130台浸没系统，计划2027年将浸没产能提升30%，并正在研究2028年再提升30%。

在中国供应商方面，SMEE早在2011年推出SSA600 ArF工具原型，但从未实现持续商业销售；2023年底一位股东声称公司已开发出28nm机器，随后撤回。新凯来（SiCarrier）在2025年SEMICON China上展示了刻蚀、CVD、PVD和ALD设备，但未展示光刻系统；2025年12月一份被报道为光刻奖项的政府合同实际涉及110nm的KrF工具。我们此前评估认为，中国设备制造商落后市场领导者十年以上。

AI Futures项目6月预测，商用可行的国产7nm浸没式扫描机将在2032年至2038年间出现，中位数为2035年，并称ASML目前占据浸没式市场98.7%的份额。2026年国产5台设备将不足ASML年浸没产量的4%，且每台设备仍需配套涂胶显影机、合格的ArF浸没光刻胶和准分子光源才能加工单一片晶圆；中国在这三项中均未领先。

history.title: Exploring Apple Silicon’s local AI performance with the Mac Studio and M4 Max — M4 Max beats GB10 and Strix Halo in decode throughput, but memory bandwidth isn't everything
history.description: Apple Silicon has been a popular choice for local AI exploration thanks to its high memory bandwidth compared to other unified memory platforms. We tested the M4 Max version of Apple's Mac Studio to see whether its 546GB/s of bandwidth makes it the clear winner in local LLM inference.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Our local AI explorations in 2026 have so far focused on two main platforms: Nvidia’s GB10, as seen in the DGX Spark and Dell Pro Max with GB10, and AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ 395, aka Strix Halo, as seen in the Corsair AI Workstation 300 and the Ryzen AI Halo. We’ve generally favored GB10 systems for these kinds of local AI development sandboxes. Their solid all-around performance and broad AI software compatibility make them easy to love, even if raw LLM inference throughput isn’t that high.But Apple’s Mac Studio is another compelling option for local AI trailblazers who want systems with large unified memory pools, powerful GPUs, and high memory bandwidth to enable faster tokens-per-second throughput than either GB10 or Strix Halo can provide. And until someone builds another unified memory SoC with a memory bus as wide as what Apple uses for its Max and Ultra chips, Apple Silicon is, in fact, the only game in town for more memory bandwidth from a chip of this design.Why focus so much on memory bandwidth for local LLM performance to begin with? To keep it very short, the decode phase of LLM inference is virtually always sequential. Every output token (starting with the first one generated as part of the prefill process) has to be run through every layer in a model in order to generate the next token, and so all the active model weights in a layer have to be streamed to the GPU from its memory as the token makes its way through each one.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Because the amount of computation required for each individual token at each layer is tiny, the speed of the entire decode process basically becomes dependent on how fast those model weights can be streamed in from GPU memory. That makes systems with large memory pools (for holding large models) and high memory bandwidth (for streaming those model weights to the GPU) appealing, and Apple Silicon is the only platform that lets you have both characteristics at a (relatively) reasonable cost.Apple’s last Mac Studio refresh was in March 2025 and marked the introduction of two versions of the system. The higher-end version uses the M3 Ultra SoC with 819GB/s of memory bandwidth across both the 28-CPU-core, 60-GPU-core mode and the 32-CPU-core, 80-GPU-core model. You may like Local AI clustering with Dell's Pro Max GB10 — connecting two Nvidia Grace Blackwell to scale out AI compute at home AMD Ryzen AI Halo review: AMD builds a DGX Spark of its own Apple quietly axes 128GB Mac Studio amid supply constraints and local AI frenzy The M4 Max version of the Mac Studio encompasses two versions with greater divergence in specs than just core counts. The base M4 Max includes a 14-core CPU (10 performance cores and four efficiency cores) with 410GB/s of memory bandwidth, and it can be upgraded to a 16-core CPU (12 performance cores and four efficiency cores) with 546GB/s of memory bandwidth.We reviewed both of these systems at launch, but Apple generously lent us another M4 Max with the 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, and 128GB of memory for LLM-specific tests. At the time, the price of that system was $3,699 or so, close to the DGX Spark’s $3,999 list price.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBut as the RAMpocalypse has rolled on, the Mac Studio has become more limited in its configuration options and harder to find in stock. The M4 Max version we tested now tops out at 64GB of RAM, and lead times for that system are over two months out. Regardless, it’s the most comparable system that Apple has for the DGX Spark and GB10 platform more generally, at least back when dollar-for-dollar meant something in this market.Before we get into performance results, we wanted to dig into the nitty-gritty of the M4 Max’s 40-core GPU, but Apple doesn’t share much (if any) detailed architectural information on its GPUs, including the number of shader ALUs that make up each GPU core, so it’s hard to directly compare the M4 Max to GB10 or the Radeon 8060S in the Ryzen AI Max+ 395. Swipe to scroll horizontally Header Cell - Column 0 Nvidia GB10 AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Apple M4 Max (16-core CPU, 40-core GPU) Available at B&H - $4,999 Amazon - $3,649.99B&H - $6,793.60 B&H - $8,499 CPU performance cores 10 16 12 CPU efficiency cores 10 Row 2 - Cell 2 4 GPU cores/SM/CU count 48 40 40 Shader ALUs 6,144 2,560 5,120 (?) GPU clock ~2450 MHz (typical) 2900 MHz ??? Unified memory 128GB LPDDR5X-8533 128GB LPDDR5X-8000 128GB LPDDR5X-8533(?) Memory bus width 256 bit 256 bit 512-bit(?) Memory bandwidth (GB/s) 273 256 546 The Radeon 8060S on board Strix Halo has 40 RDNA 3.5 compute units, each with 64 shader ALUs for a total of 2,560. AMD clocks the 8060S high, at 2900MHz, to achieve its roughly 14.8 TFLOPS of peak FP32 vector math. What to read next Apple's rumored M7 Ultra targets 1.5TB of memory and Blackwell-class AI performance, report claims Apple warns Mac mini and Mac Studio shortages could last for months Apple will skip its high-end M6 Mac chips and fast-track an AI-focused M7 generation for 2027, report claims Meanwhile, GB10 has 48 Blackwell SMs with 128 shader ALUs each for 6,144 total CUDA cores, and it too clocks relatively high, at 2450MHz in our testing. It offers a whopping theoretical 30 TFLOPS of FP32 vector compute.Way back in the day when Apple first revealed the M1 GPU, however, the company disclosed that each core encompassed 128 execution units. Assuming that the same organization has carried through to current Apple GPUs, the 40-core M4 Max GPU would have 5,120 execution units or shader ALUs. That provides an idea of the scale of the GPU, at least, though without knowing clock speeds, we’re hesitant to speculate further about peak FLOPS or other theoretical performance measures.Apple also only provides raw memory bandwidth figures for the M4 Max, but we can do some back-of-the-napkin math to surmise that the chip likely uses LPDDR5X-8533 on a 512-bit bus to achieve its 546 GB/s of rated memory bandwidth, twice as wide as both GB10 and Strix Halo. The lower-end M4 Max likely uses LPDDR5X-6400. In turn, the M3 Ultra likely uses a 768-bit-wide bus with LPDDR5X-8533 across both of its variants. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)We covered the design of the Mac Studio in detail in our initial review, but it’s worth a quick tour to re-familiarize yourself with it. The top and sides of the system are largely featureless, save for an inlaid black Apple logo up top. The front panel has two 10Gbps USB Type-C ports and a UHS-II SD card reader. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The Studio’s thermal design uses a clever intake system that draws in air from vents around the system’s circular foot before exhausting it through a vent at the back of the chassis. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)The M4 Max Studio we tested has a whopping four Thunderbolt 5 ports on its back panel with support for data rates up to 120Gbps. Although we’re not testing it today, you can enable RDMA over Thunderbolt 5 for low-latency clustering of Mac Studios using utilities like Exo. These ports also support Thunderbolt displays or DisplayPort 2.1 Alt Mode.This system also has two USB 3 ports running at 5Gbps, 10Gb Ethernet, an HDMI 2.1 port, and a headphone jack, so it’s got all the connectivity you could practically want out of a compact desktop in 2026.With those basics out of the way, let’s get to testing.

history.titleZh: 探索Apple Silicon本地AI性能：Mac Studio与M4 Max实测——M4 Max解码吞吐量超越GB10和Strix Halo，但内存带宽并非一切
history.descriptionZh:
2026年本地AI探索的主要平台集中在Nvidia的GB10（如DGX Spark和Dell Pro Max with GB10）以及AMD的Ryzen AI Max+ 395（即Strix Halo，如海盗船AI工作台300）。虽然GB10系统因其全面的性能和广泛的AI软件兼容性备受青睐，但原始LLM推理吞吐量并不高。苹果的Mac Studio为本地AI开发者提供了另一个引人注目的选择——它拥有大容量统一内存池、强大的GPU和高内存带宽，能够实现比GB10或Strix Halo更快的token/s吞吐量。目前，只要没有其他厂商制造出与苹果Max和Ultra芯片同样宽内存总线的统一内存SoC，Apple Silicon就是唯一能同时提供大内存和高带宽的芯片设计。

**内存带宽为何对本地LLM性能至关重要？** 简而言之，LLM推理的解码阶段几乎是完全串行的：每个输出token必须依次通过模型所有层，而每层所需的计算量极小，因此整个解码速度基本取决于模型权重从GPU内存中流出的速度。拥有大内存池（可容纳大模型）和高内存带宽（快速传输权重）的系统因此更具优势，而Apple Silicon是目前唯一能以相对合理成本同时提供两者的平台。

**Mac Studio硬件规格与配置**  
苹果在2025年3月推出了两款Mac Studio版本：高端版采用M3 Ultra SoC，配备819GB/s内存带宽（28核CPU/60核GPU或32核CPU/80核GPU）；M4 Max版则有两个子型号——基础版14核CPU（10性能核+4能效核）搭配410GB/s带宽，可升级至16核CPU（12性能核+4能效核）和546GB/s带宽。测试的M4 Max配16核CPU、40核GPU和128GB内存，售价约3,699美元（接近DGX Spark的3,999美元）。然而由于“RAMageddon”事件，Mac Studio配置选项受限，目前M4 Max版最高仅支持64GB内存，且交货周期超过两个月。

**GPU架构对比与性能参数**  
苹果未公开GPU核心细节，但通过历史数据推测：M4 Max的40核GPU可能包含5120个着色器ALU（每核128个执行单元），而Nvidia GB10的48个SM共有6144个CUDA核心，最高FP32矢量算力达30 TFLOPS；AMD Strix Halo的Radeon 8060S拥有40个RDNA 3.5计算单元（2560个着色器ALU），在2.9GHz频率下约14.8 TFLOPS。内存方面，M4 Max采用LPDDR5X-8533和512位总线实现546GB/s带宽（低配版为LPDDR5X-6400），而GB10为256位总线273GB/s，Strix Halo为256位总线256GB/s。M3 Ultra更采用768位总线，带宽达819GB/s。相比之下，M4 Max的内存带宽是GB10和Strix Halo的两倍，这对LLM推理至关重要。

**设计与连接性**  
Mac Studio采用底部环形进风、背部排风的散热设计。测试样机配备四个Thunderbolt 5接口（最高120Gbps），支持RDMA低延迟集群（使用Exo等工具），另有两个USB 3.0（5Gbps）、10Gb以太网、HDMI 2.1和耳机接口，作为2026年的紧凑桌面工作站连接性齐全。

**总结**  
对于需要大模型本地部署的AI开发者，Mac Studio M4 Max以其546GB/s内存带宽和128GB统一内存（现被限制）提供了比GB10（273GB/s）和Strix Halo（256GB/s）更快的LLM推理速度。虽然GPU原始算力不如GB10，但内存带宽瓶颈使其在解码阶段占优。苹果的架构优势在于通过更宽内存总线实现高带宽，这是其他平台目前无法复制的。不过，由于供应限制和配置缩水，实际选购需考虑交付周期。整体而言，Mac Studio是那些追求高token/s吞吐量、愿意接受苹果封闭生态的本地AI开发者的强力备选方案。

history.title: Google could build more AI accelerators than Nvidia sells in 2028, analyst claims — could push the company to use Intel Foundry to meet its goals
history.description: Google eyes to build more TPU AI accelerators in 2028 than Nvidia, if a report by Fubon Research is correct.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Google was among the first hyperscalers to develop its own custom AI processors about a decade ago and has been steadily ramping their deployment since then. The company seems to be so confident about its TPU v9 due in 2028 that it intends to order 12 – 15 million of such processors, according to a Fubon Research note to clients published by Sean. If the information is correct, Google may not only produce more or a comparable number of AI accelerators than Nvidia, but may also need to use Intel Foundry to meet its goals.Tom's Hardware Premium Roadmaps (Image credit: Future)High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Roadmap Nvidia Enterprise GPU and CPU RoadmapAI accelerator RoadmapDesktop GPU Roadmap3D NAND Roadmap"Based on our checks, Google plans to have 12 – 15 million TPUs in 2028," the paper reads. "Entering 2028, Google’s TPUs will enter the V9 generation with four compute dies, suggesting that their capacity consumption will more than double in 2028 versus 2027."Fubon estimates that Nvidia supplied 8.2 million data center AI GPUs in 2026 and is on track to increase the number to 12.4 million in 2028. If Fubon is correct about Google's plans to produce 12 – 15 million 9th-generation TPUs in 2028, then the company may produce more, or at least a comparable number of AI accelerators, than Nvidia in 2028.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: TSMC is not enoughHow the performance of Google's v9 TPUs will stack against Nvidia's Rubin and Rubin Ultra is something that remains to be seen, but the fact that Google intends to use four compute chiplets on these AI accelerators clearly points to the fact that the company bets big on the performance of these processors. Meanwhile, building an AI accelerator with four large compute chiplets is a major engineering effort, which Google seems to have accomplished."Although we do not have the detailed allocation yet, we think it is difficult to reach Google’s target with TSMC alone, and Intel's supply is a must by 2028," the paper continues. You may like Google reportedly books Intel for packaging more than 3 million TPUs in 2028 Google reportedly developing 'Frozen v2' chip with Gemini's architecture etched into the silicon — engineers project 6 to 10 times more tokens per watt than latest TPUs Analyst says Nvidia poised to capture two-thirds of the x86 server CPU market from Intel and AMD with expected $20 billion in revenue Researchers from Fubon are not sure whether Google's allocations at TSMC will be enough to meet the company's demand for 12 – 15 million 9th Generation TPUs, so they think that Google will have to use Intel Foundry's capacity to meet its volume goals. Over the past few months, we have seen reports claiming that Intel had landed orders to make three million TPUs for Google following months of Google's testing of Intel's advanced packaging technologies. Indeed, if Google wants to make its silicon at Intel Foundry, usage of Intel's advanced packaging services makes great sense. It should be noted that when compute chiplets are developed, they must be developed with their packaging technology in mind, as Intel's EMIB/EMIB-T and TSMC's CoWoS-L are incompatible.World's largest consumer of AI acceleratorsIf the information about Google's plans to produce 12 – 15 million TPUs in 2028 is correct (note that the difference between 12 and 15 is 20%, which is huge) and Google will indeed deploy more AI accelerators annually than Nvidia sells to the entire market, it would mark a dramatic shift in the AI hardware landscape. It will not only make Google the world's largest consumer of AI accelerators (as the company will unlikely cease buying Nvidia hardware), it will eventually make Google the owner of the world's most capable AI hardware fleet. Whether or not Google will use its overwhelming AI compute capacity primarily for its own services, or will lend the majority to other is something that remains to be seen.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsMeanwhile, for Google's rivals, the milestone will underscore the growing importance of vertically integrated AI infrastructure, where cloud providers design chips tailored to their own software stacks, workloads, and data centers instead of purchasing off-the-shelf GPUs.Yet, Google's surpassing Nvidia in unit shipments would not necessarily diminish Nvidia's dominant position. AI demand continues to expand so rapidly that both companies could increase deployments simultaneously, but Google will simply grow faster, at least till Nvidia ups production of its AI accelerators with Feynman and Feynman Ultra in 2029 – 2030. After all, Nvidia's AI GPUs are sold out. What Nvidia should worry about is not the volumes of TPUs that Google can deploy, but rather the fact that these processors do rely on a software stack that rivals Nvidia's CUDA, the company's main competitive advantage. history.titleZh: 分析师声称谷歌在2028年可能建造比英伟达销售的更多AI加速器——可能促使该公司使用英特尔代工厂以实现目标
history.descriptionZh:
Google约十年前便成为首批自研AI处理器的超大规模云厂商，此后持续扩大其TPU部署。根据富邦研究（Fubon Research）近期发布给客户的报告，谷歌对其计划于2028年推出的第九代TPU（TPU v9）信心十足，目标订购量高达1200万至1500万颗。若消息属实，谷歌不仅可能在AI加速器产量上与英伟达持平甚至超越，还可能不得不借助英特尔代工服务来实现这一目标。

**核心技术原理与创新点**  
TPU v9采用四计算芯粒（compute chiplets）设计，显著区别于前代产品。这种多芯片架构意味着谷歌在单一加速器上集成了四倍于前的计算核心，旨在大幅提升算力密度和能效。多芯粒封装是重大工程挑战，需要芯片设计与封装技术深度协同：英特尔采用EMIB/EMIB-T先进封装，而台积电使用CoWoS-L，两者互不兼容。因此，若谷歌计划在英特尔代工厂生产，则必须从一开始就针对其封装方案进行优化。这一设计思路表明谷歌对v9性能寄予厚望，意图通过堆叠芯粒实现跨越式算力增长。

**性能参数与对比数据**  
据富邦预测，英伟达2026年数据中心AI GPU出货量为820万颗，预计2028年增至1240万颗。而谷歌2028年TPU v9的产量目标（1200-1500万颗）已完全覆盖英伟达的同期规模，意味着谷歌单家企业的AI加速器产量就可能超过英伟达面向整个市场的销量。不过，两者性能的直接对比（如与英伟达Rubin和Rubin Ultra系列）尚未明确，但四芯粒设计暗示谷歌在算力上力求领先。此外，v9的功耗容量较2027年将翻倍以上，反映其算力密度的大幅跃升。

**生产与制造策略**  
富邦指出，仅靠台积电难以满足谷歌2028年如此庞大的产量需求，因此英特尔代工服务成为必选项。近期有报道称，经数月先进封装技术测试后，英特尔已获得为谷歌封装约300万颗TPU的订单。这印证了谷歌正在分散制造风险，利用英特尔在美国的产能弥补台积电的局限，并确保供应链韧性。

**技术影响与应用场景**  
若计划实现，谷歌将成为全球最大的AI加速器消费方（预计不会停止采购英伟达硬件），并有望拥有全球最强大的AI硬件舰队。这一转变将深刻改变AI硬件格局：首先，它凸显了垂直整合AI基础设施的重要性——云厂商通过自研芯片（适配自有软件栈、工作负载和数据中心）逐步摆脱对通用GPU的依赖；其次，谷歌可能将大部分算力用于自身服务（如Gemini大模型训练推理），或向第三方提供算力租赁，具体策略尚待观察。不过，谷歌在单位出货量上超越英伟达并不意味后者失去主导地位。AI需求仍在爆发式增长，双方可同步扩张，直到2029-2030年英伟达推出Feynman及Feynman Ultra系列。真正的威胁在于，谷歌TPU搭载的软件栈正挑战英伟达CUDA这一核心护城河——若谷歌的软件生态成熟，将直接削弱英伟达的差异化优势。总体而言，谷歌的庞大部署计划既是技术实力的展示，也预示AI硬件供应链和竞争格局的深刻重塑。

history.title: Nvidia's fastest graphics cards get US price increase at Best Buy, Amazon — Astral RTX 5080 now costs more than 5090's MSRP, flagship card now commands more than $4,300
history.description: Premium Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 graphics cards are once again selling far above MSRP, with some Asus and MSI models climbing close to $5,000.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you were hoping GPU prices would settle down anytime soon, you are in for disappointment. Nvidia’s RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 models from various OEM partners are once again selling well above their launch prices. As per a recent listing noticed by users on Reddit, the Asus ROG Astral RTX 5080 is now priced at $2,099.99 at Best Buy. That's $600 above its official launch MSRP of $1,499.99 and even $100 more than the flagship RTX 5090's launch MSRP of $1,999.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop RoadmapEnterprise RoadmapRubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCSimilarly, pricing for the RTX 5090 has also skyrocketed in recent months. According to a Reddit post, the Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090 is currently listed at $4,329.99 on Amazon, roughly $1,530 above its launch MSRP of $2,799.99. Even the MSI Gaming Trio RTX 5090 has gone up to $4,299.95, a whopping $1,900 more than what it was when it debuted in early 2025.That said, these hefty prices are primarily limited to premium partner models. Certain mainstream RTX 5080 cards can still be purchased closer to Nvidia's MSRP. For instance, Zotac's RTX 5080 Solid OC is selling for $1,249.99 on Amazon while PNY's RTX 5080 OC is listed at 1,256.99 at Best Buy.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While one cannot ascertain the exact reason behind this price increase, it does take us back to when tech YouTuber der8auer claimed that Nvidia has discontinued its Observed Pricing Program (OPP). This was essentially an incentive scheme that helped board partners to sell certain Nvidia products at or near MSRP. The termination of this program meant that manufacturers such as Asus, MSI, and Gigabyte gained no incentive to keep prices close to Nvidia's suggested retail price. As a result, premium custom cards have become even more expensive, with manufacturers passing higher production costs on to the consumers.In addition to that, rising DRAM prices thanks to AI-driven demand have led to a massive increase in the cost of GDDR7 memory used in RTX 50-series cards. Nvidia was also said to be prioritizing production of higher-margin products, including the RTX 5080 and AI hardware, which has further tightened supply of certain gaming GPUs.For potential customers, the latest listings suggest that waiting for premium RTX 50-series cards to return to MSRP may take longer than expected. While Founders Edition models remain the closest option to Nvidia's suggested pricing, they're often low in stock, forcing customers to choose between paying a hefty premium for high-end partner cards or settling for more affordable custom models. history.titleZh: 英伟达最快显卡在百思买和亚马逊美国涨价——Astral RTX 5080现价比5090官方建议零售价还高，旗舰卡售价突破4300美元
history.descriptionZh:
近期，NVIDIA RTX 50系列显卡的市场价格再度飙升，让期待GPU价格回落的消费者大失所望。据Reddit用户发现，华硕ROG Astral RTX 5080在百思买（Best Buy）的售价已高达2099.99美元，比官方建议零售价（MSRP）1499.99美元高出600美元，甚至比旗舰型号RTX 5090的1999美元首发官价还要贵100美元。与此同时，RTX 5090的价格同样水涨船高：亚马逊上华硕ROG Astral RTX 5090标价4329.99美元，比其首发MSRP 2799.99美元高出约1530美元；微星Gaming Trio RTX 5090也涨至4299.95美元，较2025年初上市时高出1900美元。

不过，这些高价主要出现在高端定制版（Premium Partner Models）上。部分主流RTX 5080显卡仍可接近NVIDIA官方建议价购得，例如索泰（Zotac）RTX 5080 Solid OC在亚马逊售价1249.99美元，PNY RTX 5080 OC在百思买标价1256.99美元。

此次价格暴涨背后有多重原因。首先，据科技YouTuber der8auer透露，NVIDIA已终止其“观测定价计划”（OPP）。这一计划原本是激励合作伙伴以接近MSRP销售特定NVIDIA产品的补贴机制。OPP的取消意味着华硕、微星、技嘉等厂商失去了维持官方建议价的动力，导致高端定制卡成本直接转嫁给消费者。其次，受AI需求驱动，DRAM价格持续上涨，导致RTX 50系列采用的GDDR7显存成本大幅攀升。此外，NVIDIA被指优先生产RTX 5080和AI硬件等高利润率产品，进一步收紧了游戏GPU的供应。

对潜在买家而言，最新价格动态表明，等待高端RTX 50系列显卡回归MSRP可能需要更长时间。虽然公版（Founders Edition）型号仍最接近NVIDIA建议价，但库存往往极低，迫使消费者要么为高端定制卡支付高昂溢价，要么选择更实惠的大众型号。

返校季来临，学生们需要在学业任务、截止日期和休闲时间之间找到平衡。NVIDIA GeForce NOW云游戏服务提供了一个简单的解决方案：让日常用于学习的普通笔记本电脑也能变身成为搭载GeForce RTX显卡的游戏主机。当从学习切换到游戏模式时，玩家可以立即通过云端畅玩《光环：战役进化版》——这款全球最受赞誉的游戏系列之一，本周还有另外八款游戏加入GeForce NOW游戏库。

history.title: 30 Georgia homes are being acquired via sale or eminent domain to expand power grid — one affected family member says it’s ‘for the data centers’
history.description: Georgia's largest power supply company is reclaiming 30 homes that lay in the path of its power line expansion project through sale or eminent domain. The company says the project is not for a data center, but the substation the line is connecting to sits less than five miles from a massive data center.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The largest utility company in Georgia is conducting a massive upgrade of its grid, and part of this project requires the connecting its Ashley Park Substation to Plant Wansley, which is currently undergoing an upgrade. The 35-mile stretch between the two facilities will go through Fayette, Heard, Fulton, and Coweta Counties, and require the removal of 30 residential properties along its path, reports Fortune. This included Ansley Brown’s family home, who took to Instagram to share her story.A post shared by Ansley Brown (@ansleysgarden)A photo posted by on “Georgia Power is forcibly taking people’s homes, okay? They have no choice in this matter,” Brown said in her IG post. “As you can see behind me, these are the power lines, and this is my childhood home. My childhood home is being taken by Georgia Power — they’re going to bulldoze this entire property to the ground. We don’t have a choice in this. They’re going to be expanding these power lines. Why? For the data centers. All of this is for the data centers.”Thankfully, her family was able to get in touch with their representative, Brian Jack (R-GA), who sent people on the ground to take stock of the situation and connected the two parties. Brown said in her last update that they’ve already settled with Georgia Power, with the company telling Fortune that the family has agreed to a settlement for an undisclosed amount.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: A post shared by Ansley Brown (@ansleysgarden)A photo posted by on While this ended up on a somewhat positive note for the family, this is an example of what one report previously warned about government using eminent domain to seize land for the AI infrastructure build out. Georgia Power isn’t exactly building the transmission line to connect a power plant directly to a data center, but AI data centers’ massive power demands have caused massive opposition to projects like this to appear nationwide. It also doesn’t help that an AI data center, which is being accused of secretly using up 29 million gallons of water, sits less than five miles to the southwest of the substation. (Image credit: Google Maps)Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)Photonics and high-speed data movement is the next big AI bottleneckThe data center cooling state of playMassive AI data center buildouts are squeezing energy suppliesUltra Ethernet: The data center interconnection of tomorrowThe current administration has been pushing for AI data centers, believing that it needs all that infrastructure so it can win the “AI race” against China. However, the U.S. power grid is sorely lagging behind its Asian rival, meaning U.S. power utilities and electricity providers are spending billions of dollars to upgrade the grid. This, in turn, is being passed on to every power consumer, which is heavily affecting the average American. President Donald Trump instituted and expanded the “ratepayer protection pledge” in attempt to control the spiraling costs.California has been trying to pass a law that will codify these promises, but the same tech companies that signed the pledge are also reportedly lobbying against the bill. At the moment, Oregon is the only state that has a regulation that forces big consumers (like data centers) to pay their fair share, with industries using 20MW or more getting slapped with a 30% increase in their power bill while residents and commercial users get their costs slashed by 1.3%. history.titleZh: 佐治亚州30处房屋通过买卖或征用方式被收购以扩建电网——一名受影响家庭成员称这‘是为了数据中心’
history.descriptionZh:
佐治亚州最大的公用事业公司Georgia Power正在进行一次大规模的电网升级，其中一项关键工程是将Ashley Park变电站与正在改造的Wansley电厂连接起来。这条长达35英里的输电线路将穿越Fayette、Heard、Fulton和Coweta四县，沿线需要拆除30处住宅建筑，包括Ansley Brown家的祖宅。Brown在Instagram上发帖控诉：“Georgia Power正在强行征用人们的家园，我们对此毫无选择。我身后的这些电线杆和我的童年故居——他们将把整个房产夷为平地，为的是扩建输电线路，而这一切都是为了数据中心。”幸运的是，她的家人联系上了代表Brian Jack，后者派人实地了解情况并促成双方沟通。Brown在最新更新中表示已与Georgia Power达成和解，公司向Fortune确认了和解协议，但金额未公开。

这一事件正是此前报告所警告的典型案例：政府利用“土地征用权”（eminent domain）为AI基础设施建设强行征收土地。虽然Georgia Power这条输电线路并非直接连接数据中心，但AI数据中心惊人的电力需求已在全国范围内引发了类似项目的强烈反对。更引人瞩目的是，距离这个变电站西南不到5英里处，正有一座被指控秘密消耗2900万加仑水资源的AI数据中心。

当前美国政府大力推动AI数据中心建设，认为必须在与中国的“AI竞赛”中胜出。然而美国电网远落后于亚洲竞争对手，迫使电力公司投入数十亿美元进行升级，成本最终转嫁给所有电力用户，严重影响了普通美国家庭。特朗普总统设立并扩大“纳税人保护承诺”（ratepayer protection pledge）试图遏制成本飙升，但签署该承诺的科技公司据称又在游说反对相关立法。目前，俄勒冈州是全美唯一强制大型用户（如数据中心）公平分担电费的州——用电量超过20MW的行业电费上涨30%，而居民和商业用户电费则降低1.3%。

这一事件折射出AI产业扩张与基础设施建设之间日益尖锐的矛盾：一方面，AI数据中心的能耗需求正在重塑美国电网投资方向；另一方面，土地征用、环境代价和成本分配问题正引发广泛的社会争议。尽管本案以家庭获得补偿告终，但正如Brown所言：“他们别无选择”——这为美国迎接AI时代的能源基础设施升级敲响了警钟。
